links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT's self-assessed confidence and entropy distinguished correct from incorrect answers
links.effect: Median confidence was 70% for correct answers and for incorrect answers judged correct (p<0.001). Entropy was identical for correct and incorrect responses (median 1.46, IQR 0.44–1.77).
links.quote: Entropy values were identical for correct and incorrect responses (median 1.46, IQR 0.44–1.77), indicating no discernible distinction in ChatGPT’s prediction certainty.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's accuracy and self-assessed confidence on MRCOG Part 1 and 2 examination questions without testing a specific deployment practice or workflow safeguard.
